checks: Keep the two packages distinct, combine the chilled parcel’s authorised recipients with customer absence and the reception deadline, and avoid extending opt-in across categories. Independent blind solve and item-level English, Traditional Chinese, answer and each distractor verified after language corrections.

vocabulary.note: opt in 表示主動勾選或同意某安排；對照 opt out，主動退出或不適用。

activeQuestion.prompt: Customers who opt in may have room-temperature groceries left in the lobby. Chilled parcels must go to the customer or a receptionist, who accepts them until 4 p.m. Mika has opted in. The courier arrives at 4:15 p.m. with a bag of dry groceries and a chilled parcel, but Mika is not home. The courier should ____.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 事先同意的顧客可讓快遞員把常溫食品留在大廳。冷藏包裹必須交給顧客本人或接待人員，接待人員只收件到下午四點。Mika 已事先同意。快遞員下午四點十五分帶著一袋常溫食品和一件冷藏包裹抵達，但 Mika 不在家。快遞員應該____。

options.text: leave both packages in the lobby
options.zh: 把兩件物品都留在大廳
options.whyZh: 同意只適用常溫食品；冷藏包裹不能留在大廳。

options.text: leave the dry groceries in the lobby and give the chilled parcel to reception
options.zh: 把常溫食品留在大廳，冷藏包裹交給接待人員
options.whyZh: 常溫食品可以留置，但快遞到達時已過接待人員收件的截止時間。

options.text: leave the dry groceries in the lobby without handing over the chilled parcel on this visit
options.zh: 把常溫食品留在大廳，這一趟不交付冷藏包裹
options.whyZh: Mika 同意先留常溫食品，但現在她不在家，接待人員也已停止收件，因此冷藏包裹此時無法交付。

options.text: give both packages to reception because the customer is out
options.zh: 因顧客不在家，把兩件物品都交給接待人員
options.whyZh: 接待人員四點後不再收冷藏包裹；常溫食品則可依顧客事先同意留在大廳。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: Mika 同意先留常溫食品，但現在她不在家，接待人員也已停止收件，因此冷藏包裹此時無法交付。

originalQuestion.prompt: The courier could not enter the building because no one was there to ____ the parcel.
originalQuestion.promptZh: 因為無人在場____包裹，快遞無法進入大樓。

options.whyZh: achieve 用於目標或成果，不用於收取包裹。
receive a parcel 表示接收配送的包裹，符合情境。
belong 需搭配 to，且不表示收貨動作。
occur 是不及物動詞，不能直接接 parcel。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: receive a parcel 表示接收配送的包裹，符合情境。
originalQuestion.evidence: no one was there to receive the parcel
